quote.author: Michael Scotto
quote.text: Detroit Pistons say center Jalen Duren suffered a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.

items.title: A two-week timeline for Duren suggests the severity of the hamstring isn't as bad as initially looked, but still a blow. Not a guarantee he'll return in exactly two weeks. Paul Reed and Tolu Smith will step up, and we'll see more John Collins at the five.

Paul Reed's been a big part of this 19-6 Pistons run. Ripped the ball from Garza on one end, kicked out to Green for a corner 3 on the other. 

Celtics 78, Pistons 69. 4:40 to go in the 3rd. They're finding their defensive verve again.
